CBULK.stands_in_for: every capacitance on the protected rail as one ideal capacitor at the low end of its tolerance, with no ESR, no ESL and no DC bias derating

CHOLD.stands_in_for: the hold-up reservoir at the low end of its tolerance

RBLOCK.stands_in_for: the reverse-blocking device as its on-resistance at the gate drive the whole rail gives it

RDIODE.stands_in_for: the hold-up diode as the resistance that drops its datasheet forward voltage at the logic load, which overstates the drop at every smaller current and cannot represent the blocking it also does

RFANS.stands_in_for: all four fans drawing the standard's maximum start-up current at once, as one resistance sized at the rail the channels are designed to deliver

RLOGIC.stands_in_for: the regulator and everything behind it as a fixed resistance drawing the bounded logic current

SRC.stands_in_for: the external supply at the low end of the range the board declares at its own terminal, as an ideal source with no output impedance of its own

START.stands_in_for: the instant every channel is enabled together, as an ideal switch with no on-resistance; firmware that staggers the starts sees less than this

description: every channel takes the 4-wire standard's maximum start-up current at once, and the reservoir that feeds the logic regulator is watched
name: logic_rail_on_simultaneous_fan_inrush
